high_level_description: The image depicts an outdoor equestrian setting on a sunny day. The main focus is on a person riding a horse within a fenced arena. The rider is wearing a white sleeveless top, black riding pants, and a black riding helmet. The horse is a dark brown color with a white blaze on its face and is equipped with a saddle and bridle. In the background, there are several palm trees and a row of buildings that appear to be stables or storage units. Another horse and rider can be seen further back in the arena, suggesting that this is a training or practice session.
